title: Helicopter harassment after AARO testimony
place_text: Herrera's home, father's residence and business

tellings.quote: But one of the instances, so when I testified to Arrow in April of 2023, After that trip, I started having these helicopters hover over my house or, you know, my dad's residence for example or over my business.

plain: Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says that in April 2023 he gave testimony to AARO, the Pentagon office that looks into unexplained objects in the sky. He says that after that, helicopters began hovering over his house, his father's home and his business, which he tells as a sign that someone was watching or pressuring him.
